Energy, Utilities, Environment, and Climate Committee
Wednesday, March 6, 2024
12:30 PM, 1150 Minnesota Senate Bldg.

Minutes

Present: Senator Nick A. Frentz - Chair, Senator Tou Xiong Vice Chair, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Green,
Senator Glenn H. Gruenhagen, Senator Matt D. Klein, Senator Eric Lucero, Senator Andrew Mathews, Senator Jennifer A. McEwen,
Senator Nicole Mitchell, Senator Lindsey Port, Senator Jason Rarick, Senator Bill Weber

Absent: Senator John A. Hoffman

Senator Nick A. Frentz called the meeting to order at 12:35pm

Call to Order

S.F. 4579: Senator Dibble: Single-metered utility service in residential buildings regulations and
provisions.

Senator Frentz moved that S.F. 4579, be laid on the table. - MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 3535: Senator Port: Commercial property assessed clean energy program modification.

Senator Xiong moved that S.F. 3535, as amended, be recommended to pass. - MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 4159: Senator Port: Individual taxpayer identification number when new customers apply for
utility service requirement provision.

Senator Xiong moved that S.F. 4159, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Housing and Homelessness Prevention
Committee. - MOTION PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 2:19pm

Senator Nick A. Frentz, Chair Travis Urness, Legislative Assistant
